description: Add an OpenAI-compatible agent-gateway client to the SDK: AgencyGatewayClient + client.gateway(...) facade reusing the shared CredentialsSupplier as Bearer and stamping the x-org routing header, with optional URL discovery via GET /api/agentgateways. SDK side only (design doc Phase 1, docs/gateway_design.md); contract live-validated against the local gateway on :4000.
